instruction: Set up a local filter in Thunderbird that deletes future emails from anonym-x2024@outlook.com with 'Outlook' in the subject line.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a message filter to delete all emails with 'Outlook' in the subject from anonym-x2024@outlook.com account. The evaluator checks the msgFilterRules.dat file for a filter with enabled='yes', action='Delete', and conditions checking both subject contains 'Outlook' and from contains 'anonym-x2024@outlook.com'. Uses existing check_thunderbird_filter metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks all requirements: enabled status, Delete action, subject condition, and from condition
Expected rules properly specify both conditions as a list: ['AND (subject,contains,Outlook)', 'AND (from,contains,anonym-x2024@outlook.com)']
Metric function check_thunderbird_filter correctly parses msgFilterRules.dat and matches against expected conditions
Postconfig appropriately closes Message Filters window to ensure filter rules are saved before verification
Minor type warning (str vs Union) is not a semantic issue - get_vm_file returns str when multi=False (default)

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
